444:t_000:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Warriors of $$ハイアデス$$...!」

444:t_000:3.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Lady $$エルーナ$$ has given her orders! We'll crush $c with everything we've got!」

444:t_000:5.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「We've been authorized to use $$アルデバル$$ too! Nothing can stand in our way now!」

444:t_000:7.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「We'll make this moon $$ランド・トラビス$$'s... I mean! We'll make it $c's graveyard!!」

444:t_000:8.en:
$$ハイアデス$$
(Ha! The Captain's hatred of $$ザ・ヒート$$ has gone this far!)

444:t_000:9.en:
$$ハイアデス$$
(I can't blame him. The guy's Lady $$エルーナ$$'s favorite, after all.)

444:t_000:10.en:
$$ハイアデス$$
(This is a pain. I wish he'd just charge at Lady $$エルーナ$$ already and get shot down.)

444:t_000:11.en:
$$ハイアデス$$
(Well, then we'd have to join him for a full night of drinking and whining.)

444:t_000:12.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「You there! Are you listening?!」

444:t_000:14.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「They're coming! Stay sharp! We are the mighty, invincible $$ハイアデス$$!」

444:t_001:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Those $$サイデリアル$$ bastards! Are they after $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#keyword$$?!」

444:t_001:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
「But they've also seized the $$白の宮殿$$, where Queen $$ディアナ$$ is...!」

444:t_001:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「Queen $$ディアナ$$ told us to go to $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#keyword$$. For now, we'll put everything into that!」

444:t_002:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「I've been waiting, $$ランド・トラビス$$! And $c!」

444:t_002:1.en:
$$シン$$
「He makes $c sound like an extra that comes with $$ランド$$.」

444:t_002:2.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「That $$ダバラーン$$ guy really seems to hate $$ランド$$.」

444:t_002:3.en:
$$桂$$
「It's hard being popular, huh, $$ランド$$?」

444:t_002:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「It's a pain in more ways than one.」

444:t_002:5.en:
$$メール$$
「This is all because you were ogling that Holstein, Darling!」

444:t_002:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「I wasn't, I tell you. She's the enemy!」

444:t_003:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「What's going on?! Has $$ランド・トラビス$$ not deployed?!」

444:t_003:1.en:
$$シン$$
「Does that guy only have eyes for $$ランド$$?」

444:t_003:2.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「That $$ダバラーン$$ guy really seems to hate $$ランド$$.」

444:t_003:3.en:
$$桂$$
「It's hard being popular, huh, $$ランド$$?」

444:t_003:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「It's a pain in more ways than one.」

444:t_003:5.en:
$$メール$$
「This is all because you were ogling that Holstein, Darling!」

444:t_003:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「I wasn't, I tell you. She's the enemy!」

444:t_004:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$n... How's $$ジェニオン$$ doing?」

444:t_004:1.en:
$n
「It's doing well. Activating GAI Mode should be smoother than before too.」

444:t_004:2.en:
$n
「$$ジェミニオン・レイ$$... I'll master it, no matter what...!」

444:t_004:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
(A machine guides a person... Where is $n heading...?)

444:t_005:0.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, don't worry about $$エルーナルーナ$$ in $$ゲンガナム$$! First, put everything into retaking $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#keyword$$!」

444:t_005:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Don't worry, $$ティファ$$. We'll get $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#keyword$$ back, no matter what.」

444:t_005:3.en:
$$ティファ$$
「Be careful. I have... a bad feeling.」

444:t_005:5.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Even so, we can't back down! We have to do this!」

444:t_005:6.en:
$$ロラン$$
(Please wait for us, Queen $$ディアナ$$... We'll save you, no matter what.)

444:t_006:1.en:
$$キラ$$
「Why did $$サイデリアル$$ target $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#keyword$$?」

444:t_006:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
「The truth about $$黒歴史$$ is hidden here. They probably wanted to know it.」

444:t_006:4.en:
$$甲児$$
「You mean a past you want to erase?」

444:t_006:5.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Come to think of it, that's how people used $$黒歴史$$ in $$ＡＤＷ$$.」

444:t_006:6.en:
$$キラ$$
「Some worlds that made up $$ＵＣＷ$$ were actually its distant future. Their past was called $$黒歴史$$.」

444:t_006:8.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$ＵＣＷ$$ was a multiverse too, formed from various parallel worlds, but...」

444:t_006:9.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The future in which $$ＵＣＷ$$ took the worst possible course... That was the world $$ガロード$$, $$ロラン$$ and the others came from.」

444:t_006:10.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Time lines mean nothing to a $$時空震動$$... As one possible version of a world, $$ＵＣＷ$$'s future is also a parallel world.」

444:t_006:11.en:
$$刹那$$
「The worst future of $$カミーユ$$'s $$ＵＣＷ$$, and the past of $$ガロード$$'s world... So that's $$黒歴史$$.」

444:t_006:15.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「My hypothesis: the past of the $$残されの海$$ recorded in the data left in the $$霧の海$$ is...」

444:t_006:16.en:
$$レド$$
「Stop, $$チェインバー#pilot$$. There's no need to say that.」

444:t_007:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Those aren't... enemy reinforcements, are they?」

444:t_007:2.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Captain $$ハリー$$! If you're here, Queen $$ディアナ$$ must be safe too!」

444:t_007:5.en:
$$ブライト$$
「It has been some time, Your Excellency $$ディアナ・ソレル$$.」

444:t_007:6.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「I am glad to see you in good health too, Captain $$ブライト$$.」

444:t_007:7.en:
$$ブライト$$
「What happened to $$エルーナルーナ$$, who occupied the lunar capital?」

444:t_007:8.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「She acknowledged her troops' defeat and left.」

444:t_007:10.en:
$$ランド$$
「Is that woman really the type to do that...?」

444:t_007:11.en:
$$ロラン$$
「So, Queen $$ディアナ$$... Why have you come here?」

444:t_007:12.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「I'm here to guide you to $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#keyword$$.」

444:t_007:13.en:
$$ガロード$$
「But didn't he go to sleep...?」

444:t_007:14.en:
$$正太郎$$
「What do you mean, he went to sleep?」

444:t_007:16.en:
$$ロラン$$
「$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#keyword$$ holds the sealed mind of a person once called a $$ニュータイプ$$.」

444:t_007:18.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The name is the same, but it's a little different... If anything, his abilities are closer to $$ティファ$$'s.」
